Definition: Seven, a place in Upper Egypt
BiblicalUsage: Syene is a town of Egypt on the frontier of Cush, named by its Hebrew name Seveneh. God says He will make Egypt desolate from Migdol to Syene, and the pride of her power will fall from the tower of Syene.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the far edge of Egypt is still inside God's reach — no border town is beyond His judgment or His knowledge.
